notes.title: A New Horror Game From The Lights Off! Developer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42382359/484df7e7a686d655802716c18cddb417c6c93a18.png[/img]

Take part in a dangerous ritual game in this new horror game!

After the success of Lights Off! We've been hard at work creating our next horror game. After almost a year of development, we present to you The Cullfield Ritual!

The Cullfield Ritual's full base game is available for free on itch.io, we want everyone to experience the game! However, should you want to support the endeavours, a Steam version with achievements, nightmare mode, and a non-randomized speedrun mode will be released soon!

Free On Itch: https://thedollargamestore.itch.io/the-cullfield-ritual


Steam Version: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2248880/The_Cullfield_Ritual/

notes.title: Lights Off! Joins Fearfest 2022
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42382359/c0179fb713bfcdd01477739422b119dc5408a8a0.jpg[/img]

Lights Off! has been selected to be part of the Feardemic Fear Fest 2022! Thank you to every single one of you that has played the game and helped us reach this kind of audience. We've official crossed 150k players and I'm humbled by your reception.

You can bookmark and view the event here for some exclusive behind the scenes footage and interviews here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4kA5dEBviNg
